newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade thin, prices little changed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade thin, prices little changed.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange slumped to 655 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 1,888 as demand faded after yesterday's lively trade and prices remained almost unmoved, dealers said.
Gold closed steady in dollar terms at $342.50 an ounce and firmed very slightly in lira terms to 1,598,500 per gram from Thursday's 1,588,600 lira.
The lira eased to 144,610 to the dollar from 144,070 on Thursday, accounting for gold's rise in lira terms.
Most of the day's trade -- 445 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 71.0 percent of trade in lira terms.
